name: Government & Public Sector Services Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Government Administration and Public Sector Services, covering citizen digital identity registration, permit/license processing, social welfare benefits administration, case management, public health inspections, and municipal tax collection.
owner: Global Public Sector & Citizen Services Governance Office

checklists.name: Government & Public Sector Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for citizen licensing, permit inspections, welfare eligibility, and public records access.

items.statement: Citizen identity is verified against official national/state identity registries prior to permit issuance.
Permit applications undergo field inspector review and code compliance verification.
Social welfare benefit applications evaluate household income documentation against statutory threshold tables.
Case management records log all caseworker interactions and benefit disbursement events.
Public records requests (FOIA/RTI) fulfill information disclosures within statutory response windows.

reviewGates.name: Public Agency Director Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Public Agency Director confirms that permit processing, welfare eligibility, and public record disclosures comply with administrative law.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the public sector documentation confirm statutory eligibility compliance and administrative law alignment?
